name: lightboard

frames.best_why: The word SHOWING is fully lit and centred, with the whole dot grid visible and no cursor.

tagline: Amber dot-matrix sign whose text scrolls sideways like a ticker.
summary: A wide grid of small dots renders blocky amber text that scrolls sideways like an LED sign; drawing can be enabled to light individual dots by hand.
appearance: A long black rectangular panel filled with a fine grid of dim dots, with chunky amber letters lit out of them. The message sits centred vertically in the band, with dark margins around the sign.
behaviour: The message crawls right to left on a fixed interval and wraps forever. Hovering pauses it; when drawing is enabled, dragging lights dots along the pointer path.
demo_content: The message NOW SHOWING STASHUI DOORS 7PM in amber dot-matrix letters.
search_phrases: scrolling announcement strip for a site
dot grid sign with glowing letters
use_when: You want a retro LED sign effect or a scrolling announcement strip that draws the eye.
avoid_when: The text scrolls forever and pauses only on hover; it is unreadable to screen readers and needs a wide container.
customise: text, rows, light size, gap, font, speed and dot colours are props; the glyph font and scroll direction are fixed in the source.
weight_why: The canvas is repainted on every animation frame, redrawing about 1,400 dots.

a11y.note: The canvas has no accessible text or label and scrolls continuously, ignoring reduced-motion preferences.

issues: The message is drawn into a canvas, so screen readers cannot read it.
The endless scroll ignores reduced-motion preferences.
polish_why: Convincing amber dot-matrix with even dot spacing; endless scroll and no a11y hold it back.
